findings.description: threadJoin and threadFree return values are not checked.
The code checks threadIsRunning(sortThread) and then calls threadJoin and threadFree without synchronization.
The code uses printf with user-controlled strings.
If ALGO_TEXT[1] or DESCRIPTION_TEXT[0] are empty or not properly initialized, calling .c_str() could be unsafe.
